EVALUATION AND DISPOSITION OF COMMENTS RECEIVED FROM DRAFT ENVIRONMENTAL STATEMENT
FEDERAL AGENCIES
EVALUATION AND DISPOSITION
c.)Concur
NATURE OF COMMENTS
c.) The Department of Agriculture in cooperation with the Metropolitan Sanitary District of Greater Chicago is making studies for preparation of "The Chicago Metropolitan Area River Basin Plan." This plan includes the area involved in the proposed highway improvement. To obtain further information concerning the study you may wish to contact Mr. Edgar H. Nelson, River Basin Planning Staff Leader, Soil Conservation Service, The Morton Arboretum, Thornhill Building, Route 53 and Park Blvd, P.O. Box 475, Lisle, Illinois 60532, telephone 312-964-4660.

d.) If you have questions concerning the soils, erosion and sediment control, vegetative seedings, woodland or wildlife plantings, fertilization, borrow area development or any other soil and water conservation practice don't hesitate to get in touch with Mr. Allan D. May, District Conservationist, 100 Manhattan Road, Joliet, Illinois 60433, telephone 815-723-5078.
